0022600099.text: The Bulls (0-1, 15th in the East and fifth in the Central, one game back) visit the Bucks (0-1, 13th in the East and fourth in the Central, one game back) with both teams still searching for their first win of 2026-27. Chicago is missing Dailyn Swain and Jordan Hawkins, who are out with illness, and Nic Claxton, who is out with a hamstring injury, while Milwaukee has no players listed as unavailable. In the 2025-26 season series the Bulls lost 1-3, but they won the most recent meeting 120-97 in Chicago on March 1, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
